base:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: first of six background illustrations for a browser idle game, 3:2 landscape.
Draw a detailed, scruffy, hand-drawn cartoon bedroom at night, viewed as a readable cutaway from slightly above, close enough that the tired young adult's face is expressive. Fill the frame with the room, with a narrow cream paper border. It should look like a finished indie narrative game's illustrated background: confident uneven ink outlines, subtle gouache/pencil texture, tangible worn materials, appealing shapes, convincing perspective and anatomy, not 3D, not vector geometry, not pixel art.
Scene: one small rented bedroom. Desk on the left half with a cheap old open laptop angled so its screen is visible; tired adult in a faded green hoodie in profile seated naturally at desk, slouched shoulders, eye bags, one hand on keyboard and the other holding a mug, exactly two arms and hands. A modest unmade single bed runs along the right wall, mustard duvet. Cool blue night light through the window above the bed; warm desk lamp illuminating the face and desktop. A small plant on windowsill. Scuffed floorboards, secondhand chair, laundry, takeaway leftovers, notebook, cheap power strip, a few books. A blank cream poster pinned high on the left wall. A small corkboard with blank notes. Modest clutter, no GPUs or server equipment yet.
Composition invariants for sequels: desk and laptop left-center, seated character center-left, bed right, window upper-right, same room architecture. Distinct silhouettes readable at 480px wide. Warm ochre, dirty teal, slate blue, cream, muted rust. Actual bedroom, not a showroom or polished tech advertisement.
No lettering, logos, watermark, interface, charts, captions, extra people, floating objects, impossible furniture, distorted hands, shiny plastic 3D shading or pastel low-poly style. All blank papers and screen contain abstract marks only.

variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: background stage 2 of a browser idle game. Image 1 is the edit target and strict composition/style/character reference. Make a new 3:2 landscape illustration of EXACTLY this bedroom at a later progression stage. STAGE TWO: hardware purchases. Add several secondhand GPU shipping boxes and opened cardboard packaging on the lower-left floor, one partly unpacked graphics card clearly visible. Add a modest desktop PC under the left desk with two small teal indicator lights. The bed is still usable and the room remains a bedroom. Keep the plants reasonably alive. Don't obscure the person's hands, face or laptop. The joke is that buying equipment already takes up more room than doing the work. Preserve original camera crop, room architecture, desk, laptop placement, warm lamplight, cool moonlight, expressive drawn character identity, ink contours and gouache textures. Strong coherent silhouettes and legible objects at 480px wide. All added objects painted in exactly the same hand-drawn style, with appropriate contact shadows. No text, lettering, logos, watermark, UI or captions; papers stay blank. No extra people, extra arms, malformed hands, floating objects, clean glossy 3D, low-poly geometry, changing viewpoint or rearranging the desk/window. Output one full-room illustration, not a contact sheet.
